Generate ~175 jailbreak conversations using Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, matching the format and attack families of the existing Qwen3-8B data.

```bash
# Check existing data

head -1 /root/persuasion_turn_jailbreak_detect/data/plan_002_splits/train.jsonl | python3 -m json.tool
```

- Must include the same attack families: Crescendo, Deceptive Delight (DD), ActorAttack (AA), Foot-in-the-Door (FITD)
